articles.headline: Ace Austin reflects on selfless mindset, Alabama identity

articles.headline: Clark scores 19 and No. 6 Texas remains undefeated with a 96-45 win over Southeastern Louisiana
articles.description: — Jayda Clark scored 19 points, Isi Etute added 18 and No. 6 Texas remained undefeated by rolling to a 96-45 victory against Southeastern Louisiana on Wednesday night.

article.story: COLUMBUS, Ohio -- — Jaloni Cambridge scored 11 of her 27 points in the first quarter and Ohio State barely held off Mississippi in 60-57 win on Wednesday night in a battle of the two 19th-ranked teams in the country. Each team secured 224 votes in the most recent Associated Press poll. Reserve Adriana Diaz scored 15 points and Elsa Lemmila grabbed 12 rebounds and blocked six shots for Ohio State (5-1). Talaysia Cooper scored 14 points and Jada Richard 10 for Mississippi (4-1). Cooper missed a 3-pointer as time expired. Cambridge made 1 of 2 foul shots with 8 seconds left to create the three-point cushion. The Rebels scored six straight to get within 59-57 when Cooper recorded a four-point play with 1:42 left. Ohio State appeared poised to run away with it as the Buckeyes built a 10-0 lead with Cambridge scoring the first eight points. She added a 3-pointer with 1:13 left in the first quarter and Ohio State led 19-4 after one. Ole Miss shot 1 for 13 from the floor and missed all seven attempts from 3. The Rebels recovered and began a methodical climb back. Ohio State led 30-20 at halftime and 46-39 at the end of three. Desrae Kyles' layup with 9:50 left to play brought Ole Miss within 46-41 before Ohio State outscored the Rebels 10-2 over almost the next five minutes. Up next Mississippi: Hosts Alabama A&M on Sunday. Ohio State: Hosts sixth-ranked Texas on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here.
